source: Existing metadata_json.search.filters.origin on the first received SEARCH or SEARCH_RESULT for the session in [start,end)
order: Existing server created_at, then DB id; not client action time
population: Existing observed product sessions across 17 allowed events, excluding placeholder sessions; no PAGE_VIEW requirement
registry: Pinned OriginKey enum mirrors existing Polish AIRPORT_ALIASES keys plus WAW,WMI; parity test guards drift. No arbitrary IATA-shaped metadata or DB airport names are rendered
unknown: No search event, missing/malformed/unsupported first origin, or noncanonical value. First unknown stays unknown; later valid origins do not backfill
partition: Each observed session belongs to exactly one cohort. WAW,WMI is separate from WAW and WMI and is never split. Rows sorted by origin key
share: Cohort sessions / observed_sessions, Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP two decimals; JSON string. Rounded shares may sum to 99.99 or 100.01
metric_denominator: Sessions in that cohort, not all product sessions. Numerator is distinct cohort sessions with the event anywhere inside the same window, including before the first search context
invariants: Sum of cohort sessions equals observed_sessions; sum of cohort metric numerators equals the matching global engagement numerator
not: origin currently selected at action time
empty: No sessions -> rows=[] and existing localized no_data message, no empty HTML table
compatibility: New optional origin_cohorts root field; old metrics/page_cohorts/ordered_funnel/engagement versions and definitions unchanged
privacy: Existing context only. No new tracking fields/identifiers/metadata, no airport inference from URLs/deal IDs, no raw session IDs/tokens/labels/amounts. No extra SQL queries or DB changes
